scientific_integrity: Analytic argument reconstructs the finite-dimensional linear-programming dual, exact median norm, its support function, and a bivariate central-limit transition. Finite numerical checks supplement but do not prove weak convergence.
scientific_limitations: Fixed degree two and iid uniform interval nodes; weak convergence without finite-sample error rate or implementation guarantees. Prior equivalence with uncatalogued empirical calibration-weight literature cannot be wholly excluded.
title: A non-Gaussian sharp near-equal-weight law for random quadratic quadrature
